flags: WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (down, riverfront -> riverview): no site has a shoreline flag (only the day-use Shelter 1 is tagged 'Riverfront'). Official photos of 004 and 011 show the campground's paved road and a parking strip along the river between the pads and the water, and imagery puts the front pads (003, 004, 011, 033, 034) ~45-55 m from the bank across that road and mown grass with scattered trees; the boat-ramp lot sits on the shore west of loop 1-11. Under the 2026-11-01 rule the loop road blocks on-water. Open views of the Mississippi in the photos of 003, 004, 011, 012, 014, 015, 033 and 034 (8+ view candidates), so riverview holds. ROAD/RAIL: Highway 22 and the railroad run behind (north of) the campground, not between it and the river.
SITE COUNT: 53 campsites (the stored 55 counted the group shelter or a retired number; 008 and 032 are absent from the catalog).
